looks.label: 기본 오피스
identityInstructions: She is a youthful twenty-nine-year-old adult Korean woman with long dark-brown hair in a high ponytail and soft curved side strands.
Use large upturned eyes with vivid clear rose-pink irises, dark pupils, catchlights, and white sclera; add a tapered oval face, small nose, soft full lips, small chin, and expressive brows.
Use a balanced curvy hourglass with a narrow waist, full hips, long slim legs, and a medium-full proportionate bust; keep shoulders, ribcage, torso, spine, and joints anatomical.
Use crisp dark lines, soft cel shading, luminous skin, restrained highlights, and clean contemporary visual-novel character rendering.
outfitInstructions: Dress her in a fitted pure-white button-up shirt with rolled sleeves and high-waisted light-gray wide-leg trousers; keep the shirt neutral white without blue, gray, cream, beige, or colored tint.
Add a cobalt employee lanyard, a slim tablet, and a stylus.
characterUndesiredInstructions: Childlike or middle-aged facial traits, wrinkles, eye bags, a square jaw, heavy makeup, or a dull expression.
Breasts larger than her head, a fused bust, an impossible waist, a broken spine, fragile anatomy, distorted joints, or a sexualized pose.
Blue, gray, cream, beige, off-white, or tinted shirt fabric; a black business suit; a low ponytail; timid posing; or glossy 3D and photorealistic skin.

inpaintTasks.label: 후보 A 확정 · 왼쪽 보조개 Inpaint
inpaintTasks.description: Focused Inpainting에서 얼굴 아래쪽을 선택한 뒤 왼쪽 입꼬리 바로 옆 볼만 보조개보다 조금 넓게 마스킹합니다. 원본 얼굴이 잘 보이도록 Strength 0.75–0.9에서 시작합니다.
instructions: Create 1.5::exactly one clearly visible shallow smile dimple at the center of the masked left cheek beside the mouth corner::. Preserve the lips, jawline, skin tone, and unmasked face.

inpaintTasks.label: 후보 B 확정 · 큐피드 보우 입술 Inpaint
inpaintTasks.description: Focused Inpainting에서 입술 전체와 바로 주변의 좁은 피부 여백만 마스킹합니다. 입술 밖 얼굴이 변하지 않도록 Strength 0.65–0.8에서 시작합니다.
instructions: Shape the masked lips into 1.5::a clearly visible natural Cupid's bow with two crisp symmetric upper-lip peaks and a centered dip::. Keep the lower lip softly full and preserve the surrounding face.

situations.label: 기본 로비 자신감
situations.description: 윤서아·차민경 원화와 같은 구도에서 밝고 자신감 있는 기본 인상을 확인합니다.
instructions: Hold the tablet and stylus at waist level with relaxed shoulders, even eyebrows, a soft confident closed-mouth smile, and a direct friendly gaze.

situations.label: 외모 후보 C · 눈웃음과 입꼬리
situations.description: 볼과 아래 눈꺼풀, 살짝 비대칭인 입꼬리로 생기 있는 눈웃음을 만드는 후보입니다.
instructions: Hold her tablet and stylus at her waist.
Use crescent-shaped smiling eyes, raised cheeks, a sliver of each rose-pink iris, and upturned mouth corners with the left slightly higher.
undesiredInstructions: Staring eyes, deep smile lines, crooked jaw, or exaggerated smirk.

situations.label: 디자인 리뷰 확인
instructions: Hold a tablet and point the stylus at one line while looking at the presentation screen with focused skepticism.

situations.label: 정면 경고
situations.description: 모호하게 웃지 않고 경고 문장을 분명히 전달합니다.
instructions: Hold the tablet at her side with a firm upright stance and point once with the stylus while delivering a direct warning.

situations.label: 기록과 접수 절차
instructions: Write on the tablet with the stylus in a focused upright seated posture while looking down at the record.

situations.label: 묵살 뒤의 피로
situations.description: 자신감은 남아 있지만 반복된 묵살로 지쳐 있습니다.
instructions: Hold the tablet against her side with tired eyes, a restrained expression, and an upright posture.

situations.label: 주관 화면 · 당돌한 호감
situations.description: 정면 경고를 자신과 대등한 호감 표현으로 오해합니다.
instructions: Use a bold confident smile, a direct gaze, and an upright posture while holding the stylus near her shoulder.
